note: Twelve interleaved pairs on one host. The same null broker served both runtimes. The parent drive allocated a topic Arc from a string on every record inside the measured phase. The candidate builds one Arc per cell topic before the census and clones it per record. Every run acknowledged 20,000 records. Allocation count fell from about 21,197 to about 1,196. The paired mean records/s ratio is 1.136 and the bootstrap 95% CI is 1.089 to 1.193. No pair was slower. This is a harness correction, not a library change, not a peer comparison, and not a KL09-70 claim.
